prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a sideswipe while changing lanes. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1289; do not mention it.)
text:
I represent the injured party in connection with the sideswipe collision that occurred while our client was changing lanes. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person. If your insured or any representative of your company has already made contact with our client, please let us know so that we can address it.

To allow us to evaluate the claim properly, we request a written statement of the liability limits under the policy issued to your insured, including any applicable umbrella or excess coverage, along with confirmation of the policy number and the named insured.

We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes recorded statements, photographs, vehicle data and telematics, repair estimates, adjuster notes, claim file materials, and any dash camera or surveillance footage. Please ensure that no such materials are altered, discarded, or repaired without prior notice to this office.

Thank you for your prompt attention to this letter. We look forward to your written response.
